description: Bounded calibration fixture for semantic_coherence primitive. Exercises coherence claims across artifact pairs under the four fixed evidence states.

claims.description: Two artifacts make consistent assertions about concept C1. Enough evidence is available to verify coherence.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B assert the same value for concept C1.

claims.description: Two artifacts make inconsistent assertions about concept C2. Enough evidence is available to detect the inconsistency.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B assert consistent values for concept C2.

claims.description: Cross-artifact coherence claim where the related artifact is not available.
claims.assertion: Artifact A is consistent with Artifact Missing for concept C3.

claims.description: Evidence from two sources disagrees about whether coherence holds. No single source is clearly authoritative.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B are coherent regarding concept C4.

claims.description: Coherence claim where the claim scope is not supported by available evidence. No artifact context defines the claimed concept.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B are coherent regarding undefined concept C5.
